title: Charts and the IDE
summary: Ask a chart question, open the answer, read a round-trip trace, jump to RAD Studio
intro: Read this when you first ask a chart question: how to ask one from drag-lint > Reports or with drag-lint ask, where the answer lands, how to read a round-trip trace, and the one-time draglint:// registration that makes a chart row open its line in RAD Studio. Needs a fresh project index, and Graphviz for the pictures (the installer brings it). No PowerShell is needed.

steps: Put the caret on a routine, field, type or unit
drag-lint > Reports, then pick a question
Click a chart row to jump to its line (needs drag-lint protocol register once)

questions.ask: Ask a chart question and open the chart
Make a chart row open its line in RAD Studio (once per user)
